name: Templates
description: Reusable, structured-data templates: a JSON Schema plus optional AI-assist config (stored preference only, no AI engine), categories, tags, and public sharing. Ships a /templates page listing the signed-in owner's templates with create/edit via the generic schema-driven form (window.dbbasicForm) and list (window.dbbasicList). 0.3.0 deletes the bespoke site_templates page object: it was ~90 lines of chrome around two generator calls with no business logic of its own, and is now a seeded VIEW record over the same `list` block /notes uses.
